title: The Man Who Declared Himself Emperor
description:
Joshua Norton was a San Francisco resident who declared himself Emperor of the United States in 1859, signing as 'Norton I', and added the title Protector of Mexico in 1866. He had gone bankrupt in 1856 after a failed business deal. He issued his own scrip, which some restaurants accepted, and called for a suspension bridge or tunnel between Oakland and San Francisco. The Bay Bridge opened in 1936, and there have been efforts since the 1930s to name it after him.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Joshua Norton'.

Who else deserves an imaginary title? Tell us in the comments.
